descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Construcții, Dezvoltare de software și Servicii IT și consultanță IT
N-iX is a global software development service company that helps businesses across the globe create next-generation software products. Founded in 2002, we unite 2,400+ tech-savvy professionals across 40+ countries, working on impactful projects for industry leaders and Fortune 500 companies. Our expertise spans cloud, data, AI/ML, embedded software, IoT, and more, driving digital transformation across finance, manufacturing, telecom, healthcare, and other industries.
Within our multidisciplinary engineering environment, we work on advanced autonomous and unmanned systems. Our R&D scope spans multirotor, fixed-wing, VTOL and lighter-than-air platforms, with a focus on guidance, navigation, control, perception and sensor integration. Engineers work alongside specialists in electronics, mechanics, embedded software, mathematics, CV/AI and signal processing to take solutions from modeling and simulation through integration and physical validation.
 Responsibilities:
Design and integrate advanced guidance, navigation and control (GNC) systems for different flight dynamics
Develop and validate control algorithms, state estimation, flight models and autonomous behaviors
Select and integrate flight controllers, radar, cameras, GNSS/INS, other sensors and onboard computing
Integrate CV/AI perception, tracking, localization, radar/DSP and multi-sensor fusion
Build simulation and emulation environments; perform SIL/HIL, hardware integration and field validation
Collaborate with hardware, mechanical, embedded, CV/AI, mathematics and signal-processing specialists.
 Technical Skills:
Programming: Python, Linux; C/C++ as required.Control & GNC: flight dynamics, PID/LQR/MPC, feedback control, trajectory planning, EKF/UKF, GNSS/INS
UAV platforms: PX4 or ArduPilot, MAVLink/MAVSDK; flight-controller and companion-computer integration
Sensors & signals: IMU, radar, GNSS, LiDAR, cameras, DSP, filtering and sensor fusion
Interfaces: CAN, UART, SPI, I²C, Ethernet, telemetry and diagnostics.
 Additional Advantages:
SLAM, VIO, RTK GNSS, radar principles (FMCW/Doppler), robust or adaptive control
NVIDIA Jetson, CUDA/TensorRT, embedded Linux/RTOS; Docker, CI/CD and cloud services
Perception & AI: OpenCV, object detection/tracking, PyTorch or TensorFlow, ONNX
Hands-on commissioning, tuning and flight testing of real unmanned platforms
Simulation: ROS 2, Gazebo or MATLAB/Simulink, SIL/SITL/HIL testing.
 What We Expect:
4+ years in UAV, aerospace, embedded software or autonomous systems
Strong system-level understanding and practical software/hardware integration experience
Ability to evaluate alternatives, coordinate domain specialists and take solutions from concept to validated prototype
Independent R&D thinking, structured troubleshooting and technical English.

Flexible working format - remote, office-based or flexible
A competitive salary and good compensation package
Personalized career growth
Professional development tools (mentorship program, tech talks and trainings, centers of excellence, and more)
Active tech communities with regular knowledge sharing
Education reimbursement
Memorable anniversary presents
Corporate events and team buildings
Other location-specific benefits
